lines.t: I hear the wind, it whispers grace
The stars above, they light the way
Each step I take is not my own
Your voice, it calls my heart to bow
I will obey, whatever you say
Your love is my guide, my hope, my stay
Mountains rise, but I won't fear
Your hand, it wipes away each tear
The path is narrow, but you're near
Your word, it burns within my soul
Take my life and make it whole
I will obey whatever you say
Your love is my guide, my hope, my stay
